templates.why_chosen: Star, high-confidence two-tier layered exemplar, a blue Server box over an orange Client box over a GPU row, where circled numbers 1-5 on the connecting arrows trace a profiling-optimization-schedule-feedback loop around an embedded lookup-table object.
templates.what_to_learn: Embed a small data object, such as a lookup table with one highlighted row, inside the tier that owns it rather than describing it in prose, and number the back-and-forth arrows between just two tiers in interaction order even when several arrows point the same direction, so the loop reads sequentially.

templates.why_chosen: Numbered steps 1-5 trace a full server-to-client-to-server cycle (profile, optimize, deliver schedule, straggler-notify back), with the two tiers colour-coded blue/green and the chosen schedule row picked out in orange.
templates.what_to_learn: Number every arrow in the server-client cycle in one continuous sequence, even where it re-enters the server (step 4's straggler notification), and colour the two tiers distinctly (blue server, green client) so the reader always knows which side owns each step.
